pages.text: Trinkets are small pieces of tech you wear. They let you hover over the ground, see in the dark, zoom in, read your machines from afar, call your Taxi drone and have your drops picked up for you.$(br)$(li)$(l:trinkets/gravity_boots)Gravity Boots$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:trinkets/neural_chip)Neural Chip$(/l)

$(li)Build a $(l:trinkets/trinket_table)Trinket Table$(/l). Every trinket and program is made there.$(br)$(li)Make a $(l:trinkets/utility_belt)Utility Belt$(/l) and an $(l:trinkets/energy_sphere)Energy Sphere$(/l), and put the sphere in the belt. The sphere is the battery of all your trinkets.$(br)$(li)Make the trinkets you want and put them on.
pages.title: Getting started

pages.text: Open your inventory and click the $(l)Trinkets$() tab above it (in the creative inventory, it is down the right side). The tab has three slots of its own: $(l)Neck$(), $(l)Belt$() and $(l)Feet$(). Shift-click a trinket to put it on. What you wear shows on your character.
pages.title: Where you wear them

pages.text: These are not armor slots, so you keep your armor. Trinkets give no armor and never wear out.$(br2)With $(l)Curios$() installed, the trinkets go in three Curios slots of their own instead (CyberFarm's Neck, Belt and Feet), never in the other mods' slots.
Your trinkets are $(l)kept$() with keepInventory on. Otherwise they $(l)drop$() where you died, like the rest of your inventory. With Curios installed, Curios' own rules decide.
pages.title: When you die

pages.text: $(li)$(l:trinkets/utility_belt)Utility Belt$(/l): Belt, Holds the Energy Sphere, your tools and the Pocket Drone, B (open)$(br)$(li)$(l:trinkets/energy_sphere)Energy Sphere$(/l): in the belt, Powers every trinket; charges the FE items you carry,$(br)$(li)$(l:trinkets/pocket_drone)Pocket Drone$(/l): in the belt, Picks up drops around you, K
pages.title: Every trinket

pages.text: $(li)$(l:trinkets/gravity_boots)Gravity Boots$(/l): Feet, Hover over the ground, no fall damage, H$(br)$(li)$(l:trinkets/neural_chip)Neural Chip$(/l): Neck, Runs up to six programs: zoom, night vision and more, Z, N, J$(br)You can change every key in Controls, under $(l)CyberFarm Trinkets$(). A trinket's tooltip shows the key it is bound to now.

Every trinket runs on the Energy Sphere in your belt. With no sphere, or an empty one, they stop. Only the Zoom program works without power.$(br)$(li)$(l)Gravity Boots$(): 12 FE/t while you hover$(br)$(li)$(l)Night Vision Program$(): 2 FE/t while it is on$(br)$(li)$(l)Machine Link Program$(): 1 FE/t
pages.title: Power use

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Geiger HUD Program$(): 1 FE/t while it shows radiation$(br)$(li)$(l)Auto-Feeder Program$(): 50 FE per meal$(br)$(li)$(l)Pocket Drone$(): 1 FE/t in flight, from its own battery; the sphere refills it at up to 10 FE/t$(br)To store FE for your trinkets in bulk, see the $(l:energy_storage/battery_bank)Battery Bank$(/l).
